name: Earlier warning with abstention
owner_problem: Periodic tests leave long blind intervals, while noisy alarms destroy trust.
hypothesis: Continuous low-cost trajectories plus reference chemistry can produce valid warning lead time without unacceptable false alarms, and can abstain when evidence is weak.
comparator: The same periodic reference-test schedule without continuous fusion.
falsification: Fusion produces no material lead-time gain, misses important events, or requires a false-alarm rate owners will not accept.
first_experiment: Run the existing V0 passive observational protocol and report event-level lead time, misses and false alarms.
safety_boundary: No harmful livestock perturbation and no automatic equipment control.

name: Sensor trust and self-diagnosis
owner_problem: A plausible-looking bad sensor can cause confident but wrong advice.
hypothesis: Calibration, drift, cross-signal contradiction and device-health evidence can identify when a measurement should be trusted, degraded or rejected.
comparator: Threshold logic that treats every received value as valid.
falsification: Quality signals do not predict measurement error or add too much maintenance burden.
first_experiment: Characterize warm-up, repeatability, calibration residuals, dropout and drift for each V0 sensor before aquarium deployment.
safety_boundary: Suspect measurements can only reduce confidence or request verification.

name: Reference chemistry fusion
owner_problem: Direct continuous analyte sensing is often too costly or fragile for a first home experiment.
hypothesis: Periodic ammonia/KH/nitrite/nitrate observations can label and constrain cheaper continuous pH, temperature and conductivity trajectories.
comparator: Continuous proxy readings alone and periodic chemistry alone.
falsification: The combined signals do not improve decision quality or the reference cadence is too sparse for evaluation.
first_experiment: Synchronize reference-test and telemetry timestamps with explicit method, freshness and calibration provenance.
safety_boundary: No proxy is relabelled as ammonia, toxicity or diagnosis.

name: Closed-loop aquarium digital twin
owner_problem: Most logs stop at a reading or recommendation and do not learn what happened after an intervention.
hypothesis: A time-aware decision-action-outcome twin improves usefulness and reduces repeated unnecessary interventions.
comparator: A conventional parameter log and reminder workflow without outcome comparison.
falsification: Owners do not complete outcome checks or the history does not improve later decisions.
first_experiment: Measure outcome-check completion and decision usefulness in the existing manual-first product loop.
safety_boundary: Tank-specific history never relaxes reviewed welfare constraints.

name: Minimum biological observability envelope
owner_problem: Hardware support is usually binary even though evidence quality varies by decision.
hypothesis: Each biological decision has a measurable minimum combination of sensor quality, cadence, calibration and reliability below which the system should degrade or abstain.
comparator: Global supported/unsupported device labels without decision-specific evidence.
falsification: Decision error cannot be usefully related to instrumentation capability or qualification costs exceed the value.
first_experiment: After V0, replay the same dataset under controlled down-sampling, noise and dropout conditions and measure decision degradation.
safety_boundary: Qualification begins observe-only; low confidence disables inference/actuation.

name: Behavior-water multimodal warning
owner_problem: Water data may miss early animal responses, while behavior alone is ambiguous.
hypothesis: Non-invasive behavior features add predictive information when interpreted with water, equipment and context evidence.
comparator: Water/context fusion without video-derived behavior features.
falsification: Behavior features add no robust incremental information or generate unacceptable privacy, compute or false-alert burden.
first_experiment: Use safely observed, owner-labelled clips only after V0; quantify incremental information gain and confounders.
safety_boundary: No disease diagnosis, invasive tagging or required continuous private-home video upload.

name: Individual baseline without identity commerce
owner_problem: Group-level observation can hide a single fish's sustained behavioral change.
hypothesis: Opt-in local recognition may support individual welfare baselines without creating passports, ownership history or marketplace identity.
falsification: Recognition is unreliable across ordinary tank conditions or the welfare value does not justify privacy/product complexity.
first_experiment: Do not start until the core loop and multimodal value are proven; then run an offline, opt-in feasibility study.
safety_boundary: Fish Passports, ownership transfer, valuation and marketplace uses remain excluded.

name: Home-to-RAS evidence bridge
owner_problem: Consumer aquariums and industrial RAS tools generate evidence in incompatible cost, reliability and operating contexts.
hypothesis: A shared provenance/event contract could allow methods to transfer while keeping customer, safety and hardware assumptions explicit.
falsification: The contexts differ so much that shared contracts produce misleading comparisons rather than useful transfer.
first_experiment: Map fields and failure semantics only; do not build an integration before Open Aqua has real V0 data.
safety_boundary: Industrial automation rules never inherit into home control authority.

name: Capability-qualified low-cost edge
owner_problem: Cheap or refurbished compute may be usable for some roles but unsafe or unreliable for others.
hypothesis: Role-specific capability tests can qualify heterogeneous devices as qualified, degraded, observe-only or unsupported.
comparator: Brand/model allowlists without measured role performance.
falsification: Qualification cannot be made repeatable or hardware variability overwhelms lifecycle savings.
first_experiment: After V0 stabilizes, compare timing, buffering, ADC/interface behavior, reboot recovery and decision disagreement across two devices.
safety_boundary: No mains-device modification; low-voltage observation first.

name: Evidence-portable digital twins
owner_problem: Digital-twin claims often hide differences in source quality, model scope and update semantics.
hypothesis: A compact provenance-rich evidence packet can make aquarium state and model outputs comparable without centralizing domain truth.
comparator: Dashboard exports lacking source, freshness, confidence and model version.
falsification: The packet is too costly to maintain or cannot support reproducible decisions across systems.
first_experiment: Export one read-only V0 evidence packet after real telemetry exists and reproduce one decision from it.
safety_boundary: The packet carries evidence, not permission to act.

name: Maintenance burden as a first-class metric
owner_problem: A sensor can look inexpensive while calibration, fouling and replacement make it unusable.
hypothesis: Including maintenance minutes, drift and missed-data cost changes which sensor set is truly minimum-cost per useful inference.
falsification: Maintenance differences are negligible or cannot be reliably measured.
first_experiment: Log every calibration, cleaning, replacement, failed reading and operator minute during V0.
safety_boundary: A low purchase price never overrides measurement trust.

name: Human verification before intervention
owner_problem: Fast automation can amplify a bad measurement or wrong causal interpretation.
hypothesis: An evidence-ranked verification request can capture much of early-warning value while avoiding premature autonomous control.
comparator: Immediate rule-based actuation from thresholds or opaque ML output.
falsification: Verification delays erase useful lead time or owners cannot complete the required check reliably.
first_experiment: For each observational warning, record the smallest requested verification, response time and whether the evidence changed the decision.
safety_boundary: AI output is never actuation authority; autonomous equipment control remains outside current product scope.
